Meetion BTM001 Dual Mode Wireless Mouse White Edition (Dual Wireless Connection Bluetooth & 2.4GHz USB / Silent Mute Buttons / Adjustable Optical DPI Sensor / Compact Ergonomic Body / Power-Saving Auto Sleep / 1-Year Official Agent Warranty)

Upgrade your daily workflow with the Meetion BTM001 Dual Mode Wireless Mouse in clean White Edition, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with a 1-Year Official Agent Warranty (ضمان سنة من الوكيل). Designed for versatility and quiet operation, the BTM001 features dual wireless connectivity via Bluetooth and 2.4GHz USB receiver, ultra-quiet silent clicking switches, an adjustable DPI optical sensor, and a compact ergonomic profile ideal for work, travel, and home environments.
